messages:
Nina: Hello team, Nina here on my first day in infra. I'm trying to run the onboarding checklist steps that need GCP project `partner-test-08` access and to assume an AWS role `arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/PartnerReadOnly`. I can open the project console but the Compute -> VM Instances page shows 'Permission denied (403)'. Need to run a quick latency probe from asia-southeast1. Who can help grant minimal rights?

Leo: Welcome Nina! For the GCP side we usually grant `roles/compute.viewer` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on the CI service account if you need to impersonate. For AWS, we add you to `crossacct-readonly` group which the role trusts. Do you have your SSO principal name?

Nina: SSO: redwood/nina. Email: nina@redwood.com. For GCP, the service account is `ci-sa@partner-test-08.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. The 403 is only on VM Instances; I can view logging and storage.

Leo: That suggests a project-level IAM restriction: probably `roles/compute.viewer` not granted to your user. Also check if there's an organization VPC-SC policy but unlikely for just viewing VMs. Can you run: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy partner-test-08 --format=json` and paste redacted output?

Nina: Pasted (redacted): bindings include `group:partner-admins@redwood.com` and `serviceAccount:ci-sa@partner-test-08.iam.gserviceaccount.com` but no user bindings for me. Also org policy shows `constraints/restrictResourceLocations: [europe-west1]` on the folder.

cloud-security: FYI if the folder restricts to europe-west1 only, asia-southeast1 is blocked at folder level. We can grant a temporary project exception but need a business justification and finance sign-off if it may incur charges. What's the test?

Nina: It's a 2-hour latency probe connecting to partner endpoints in Singapore to validate TLS configs. Expected cost under $5. Temporary exception is fine.

Leo: Okay I'll request a 48 hour exception for `asia-southeast1` on the project and grant `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1` scoped narrowly so you can create one small VM. For view-only, I'll add `roles/compute.viewer` to your user too. For AWS I'll check the trust policy.

ops-bot: Creating ticket CLOUD-8510: "Onboard Nina: GCP compute viewer + temporary APAC exception + AWS assume-role check". Assigned to infra and cloud-security. ETA 1 business day.

cloud-security: Checked AWS role trust: it allows `arn:aws:iam::333222111000:role/OktaSSORole` and group `crossacct-readonly`. It doesn't enumerate individual SSO users. We should add you to `crossacct-readonly`. Leo, can you request cloud-identity to add redwood/nina to that group?

Leo: Sure, requesting group add. Also opening a finance note for the temporary exception. @finance can you ack cost OK for a $5 probe?

finance: Acked — temporary exception for up to $20 approved for onboarding probes. No extra billing request required. Will audit usage.

ops-bot: CLOUD-8510 updated: temporary group `onboard-apac` to be created; request to add nina@redwood.com to `crossacct-readonly` issued; project exception requested.

Nina: Thanks all. Once the compute role and exception are in place I'll run the probe and post results. If you need exact commands I'll paste them here.

Leo: Added `roles/compute.viewer` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` for `nina@redwood.com` on project `partner-test-08`. Requested `asia-southeast1` for 48h. Cloud-identity request to add you to `crossacct-readonly` submitted. Expect changes in ~30-60m.

Nina: I can now list VMs and create a small n1-standard-1 in asia-southeast1. Probe passed, latency ~85ms to partner endpoint. Thanks everyone! :tada:
